name: Marin Transit: Paratransit
fullDescription: Marin Transit provides ADA paratransit service (Marin Access) for people in Marin County who cannot use regular local bus service due to a disability. You don't need to be a Marin resident if you're certified anywhere in the Bay Area.
whatTheyOffer:
- Door-to-door shared ride service
- Local service within Marin County ($4 one-way) and regional trips (200% of Golden Gate fare)
- Reservations 1-7 days in advance
- Same-day service pilot for local trips on an as-available basis (premium fare)
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
- Personal care attendants ride free
howToGetIt:
1. Call Travel Navigators at 415-454-0902 to start the application
2. Complete the application and provide a licensed professional's statement
3. An assessment may be required; decisions within 21 days
4. Once certified, schedule rides by phone
keywords: Marin Transit, paratransit, ADA, Marin County, disability, wheelchair, door to door, San Rafael
